title: Page 64
transc:
Geo. D. Sheldon  Washn May 4th 1864 2.30 P. M
Growl Henrietta May Penny For Knox unity Jupiters
Oyster has Pocketed the Audit Youth Italy zebra
Here is Judah's message From Germ ana Rusty
May Pension For Inland Grapes Zodiac The pocketing
of Audit effected zodiac Lampoon Platina hours now
will demonstrate whether the Rome intends giving Parson
this side of Garden zebra wrangle Know that 
we have Pocketed the Audit Walrus John Chinamen


F. S. Van Valkenburg Chat  Washington May 4th 1864 3 0 Pm
Growl Jennie May Pension For Kennebec unity Some
Harsh Waldo torch Militia raised in Western
States will be placed under your Polka zebra
I propose to send some to Dolphin Embrace
and Drum zodiac To what other places shall
I send them Star The Wilcoxes should be
ordered to the field as fast as replaced
by militia Yoke Jacob give us first news


JW Sampson Balto  Wash May 5th 1 pm 1864 
Harriet for J W Garrett unity Abner whist
are ordered to the line of your Weldon
and Gov B rough has been requested to 
send them immediately Walrus Bruno
